button.adaptation: Square, high-contrast controls with one filled signal-red action per region and immediate pressed feedback.
button.notes: Remove decorative shadows and preserve a 44px target, visible focus, and single-line labels.

navigation-menu.adaptation: Align the wordmark, four destinations, and Tickets action to the twelve-column grid.
navigation-menu.notes: Active routes use weight plus a 2px rule and aria-current. Mobile uses a focus-trapped full-height sheet.

card.adaptation: A flat film record with a consistent still crop, title, compact facts, and one clear link.
card.notes: Use space and rules instead of elevation. No critic scores, laurels, or image overlays.

badge.adaptation: Compact category and state labels with square geometry and redundant text cues.
badge.notes: Ticket status always includes a word and glyph; red alone never signals availability.

data-table.adaptation: The source-of-truth schedule with caption, header cells, day groups, sortable facts, and keyboard-selectable rows.
data-table.notes: Below 768px render scannable day lists instead of forcing horizontal table scrolling.

combobox.adaptation: Plain venue, category, and sort filters with persistent labels and URL-backed values.
combobox.notes: The popup and trigger inherit the same semantic tokens and visible focus treatment.

filter-group.adaptation: Category and day options use aria-pressed with a check glyph and weight change for selection.
filter-group.notes: Do not rely on a red fill as the sole selected-state cue.

calendar.adaptation: A secondary schedule view limited to the fixed festival days, with a marked count and the list retained beneath it.
calendar.notes: The table or list remains the source of truth. Do not imply live ticket inventory.

pricing.adaptation: Compare single screening, day pass, and festival pass without a fabricated featured plan.
pricing.notes: All prices and policies remain visibly marked placeholders until confirmed.

accordion.adaptation: Numbered FAQ groups with direct questions, plain answers, and anchored headings.
accordion.notes: Preserve native heading order, keyboard behavior, and expanded-state text.

footer.adaptation: A near-black four-column footer for identity, festival navigation, visit details, and placeholder contacts.
footer.notes: No sponsor logos or implied partnerships. Repeat the demo notice in the legal line.

form.adaptation: A demo checkout form with persistent labels, explicit required markers, and local-only review state.
form.notes: Retain entered values after validation errors and never request or imply payment.
